content:
**Nuka-Cola Dark** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Nuka-Cola Dark was the Nuka-Cola Corporation's attempt at entering the alcoholic beverage market and appealing to the adult demographic. A ready to drink bottle of Nuka-Cola and rum with an alcohol-by-volume content of 35%, the beverage was touted as "the most thirst-quenching way to unwind." Those partaking in the drink were recommended to not operate motor vehicles or heavy machinery for at least eight hours after drinking, and encourage women who are pregnant or may become pregnant to avoid the drink. [1] It sold successfully in many of the finer lounges and restaurants across the nation. [2] It can be found after the war in locations such as the Nuka-World theme-park in the Boston Commonwealth, or at the Appalachian Whitespring Resort.

A dark-colored alcohol made from Nuka-Cola and distilled Snaptail Reeds. It increases Strength and Endurance by one while also lowering Perception by one.

Similar to other fermentable beverages, Nuka-Cola Dark is initially crafted as fermentable Nuka-Cola Dark, offering no benefits and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented. It shares the same rocket-shaped bottle as other iterations of Nuka-Cola, but is darker in color and has a distinct decorative label.

Nuka-Cola Dark can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.

- It can be purchased from Bubbles, upstairs in the Whitespring Resort, or crafted at a Brewing Station.
- One can be found at the Eta Psi House at Fraternity Row, inside the basement's Nuka-Cola room.

- Unlike other fermentable pre-War beverages, fermentable Nuka-Cola Dark doesn't inflict 30 rads when consumed.
- The Nuka-Cola Dark recipe can be awarded by doing the Wasted on Alcohol daily quest as a random reward.
- Can spawn in an unmarked information booth on the road between Ripper Alley and Emmett Mountain Disposal Site, in the Nuka-Cola machine.

1. ↑ World of Refreshment tour: *"Hey Mom and Dad, are you ready for a night out on the town? Then pick up an ice-cold Nuka-Cola Dark and experience the most thirst-quenching way to unwind. Nuka-Cola Dark: that refreshingly familiar Nuka-Cola taste with a light alcoholic twist. 35% alcohol by volume. Do not consume Nuka-Cola Dark if you are pregnant or planning on becoming pregnant. Do not operate motor vehicles or heavy machinery for at least 8 hours after drinking."*
(World of Refreshment announcer's dialogue)
2. ↑ *Nuka-World* loading screens:*"Nuka-Cola Dark was the corporation's attempt at entering the alcoholic beverage market. Boasting 35% alcohol-by-volume, the unusual soft drink found its success at many of the finer lounges and restaurants around the country."*
